lines.text: BinLogic is a warehouse management system for brands and retailers that run their own fulfillment.
BinLogic is built mobile-first: floor work such as receiving, putaway, picking and cycle counts runs on a handheld device.
BinLogic supports multi-location retail operations, including store transfers and cycle counting.
BinLogic can support buy-online-pick-up-in-store workflows where store inventory is tracked in the system.
binlogic.io hosts free tools: a freight identifier validator (freightID) and an SSCC-18 label generator.
Demos are booked from the site ("Get a demo").
